Week 21 Module Map: The Civil War and Reconstruction

Quarter 3: The Price of Union

Texans fight on two fronts at once, then live through the undoing of the system the war was fought to defend. It is a big week, so take it one lesson at a time.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: Texans in the Civil War: East and West
  • Lesson 2: Reconstruction in Texas

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 21 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 21 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 21 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Perseverance: notice it in the Texans who fought on in Virginia and the Trans-Mississippi, and in the freedpeople who built schools and churches.
